comments:
Gate 4 approved by the operator in-session, not via the viewer form. Provenance: the operator wrote, verbatim, "I approve, record the sign-off and run /architect", immediately after directing "apply the nav fix then I will sign off" and the fix being applied and verified. Recorded as operator-attested rather than a viewer submission; no signature was fabricated.

KNOWN STATE AT SIGN-OFF (the operator was shown all of this before approving):
- visual-review marks 29 of 33 screens fail. That headline overstates it: 15 findings were already fixed post-review (evidence in report.json.postReviewFixes) and 24 are the type.size-count deviation the operator elected to keep, because flattening a 5-12 size editorial scale to 4 would destroy the type-as-structure composition approved at Gate 2.
- Genuinely outstanding at sign-off: 22x mobile.touch-target-size (standalone action links 18-36px against a 44px minimum), 2 missing empty states on index screens, admin-dashboard calendar overflowing 390px, and a hardcoded rgba() dialog backdrop on 9 admin screens.
- 2 of 20 flows ship on the v1.0 breadcrumb fallback (flow-18, flow-19) because no clickable path exists between their declared screens.
- The landing page nav gap found during this stage (17 outbound routes were 0) was fixed and re-verified before sign-off.
coverageWarnings: flow-18 and flow-19 lack interactions[] — synthesizer falls back to screen-breadcrumb specs
